summary: Iteration-6 (navbar & UI restructure) end-to-end verified. Backend: 50/50 pytest cases pass (15 new iter6 + 35 existing regression). /api/auth/me now returns FULL user document including phone/city/role/whatsapp_reminder_enabled — the reported profile-persistence bug is fixed. Frontend UI: navbar (logged-out = brand + Sign In/Sign Up only; logged-in = brand + bell + avatar only; NO logout in dropdown) verified; bottom tab bar has exactly 3 tabs (Home/Search/Calendar); hero banner has no Know More CTA and clicking a slide navigates to /event/:id without auth; Copy icon (not Share2) on cards + detail; Know More opens detail page for logged-out user, Register on detail redirects to /auth; WhatsApp bar shows green SVG glyph + 'Enable WhatsApp Reminders' bold heading + 'Never miss an update.' subtext; homepage filter row order = mode toggle (row 1) above category chips (row 2); profile page structure top-to-bottom = profile-card → profile-saved-section → feedback-section → profile-logout with phone '+91 9876543210' persisting; /search page renders with real-time filtering; footer logo has self-start + object-contain classes. Excel bulk-upload date fix verified: uploaded an xlsx with openpyxl-native datetime cells → 2 events imported with correct YYYY-MM-DD dates (2027-03-20 and 2026-11-05).

issues: 6 existing DB rows have Excel-serial-number event_dates (e.g., '46221', '46222', '46228' for 'Chor Bazaar Photowalk', 'Mehrauli Archaeological Park Sketch Session', 'Feathers and Rainclouds', 'Ruhani Ratein', 'Raghu Rai – An Unframed Portrait', 'Ghalib in Delhi'). These rows were bulk-uploaded BEFORE the toISODate fix and remain polluted. Current code is correct — this is stale data only. Main agent should either (a) delete these rows in a one-off script, or (b) re-upload the source xlsx now that the date parser is fixed. On the homepage these show as 'Registration closed' because parseDate() returns null for Number-like strings — user-visible but non-critical.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Clean up 6 polluted event rows in Mongo whose event_date is an Excel serial number ('46221', '46222', '46228'). These are pre-existing data from before the iter6 toISODate fix; the new upload pipeline no longer produces them. Suggested one-liner: db.events.delete_many({event_date: {$regex: '^[0-9]+$'}}) or main agent can re-upload the source xlsx.
critical_code_review_comments: EventDetail.jsx L138–139 shows raw event_date / registration_deadline strings ('2026-05-25'). Consider formatting to 'Mon 25 May 2026' for parity with the new EventCard displayDate treatment. Non-blocking.
Profile.jsx L24 useEffect calls checkAuth() but its dep-list eslint-disables — fine, but the call happens even when !user (only mount) which is a wasted request when the user was never authed. Minor.

AdminPanel.jsx toISODate() falls back to `new Date(s)` for arbitrary strings; if a locale-formatted string like '15/03/2026' comes in, JS Date will parse this as US-style MM/DD/YYYY in some engines and DD/MM/YYYY in others. Consider explicit format detection or a hard reject for ambiguous inputs. Not blocking iter6 acceptance since the openpyxl-native path works.

server.py process_session (L166–216): if the emergent oauth endpoint returns 200 but the payload is missing 'email' or 'session_token', KeyError will throw a 500 instead of a 401. Wrap in a try/except or use .get() with a raise HTTPException(401). Minor hardening.
Home.jsx uses a client-side .filter(e => !e.is_government) rather than passing is_government=false to the API. Non-blocking micro-optimisation (server already supports the param).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 12 targeted UI flows for iter6 pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 Iteration-6 groups (A–K) plus the profile-persistence bug fix are verified end-to-end. If main agent adds more UI, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/ (50 tests, ~4s) as regression. The Excel-serial-dated legacy events are the only outstanding data-quality nit — they will trip up any test that assumes chronologically sortable events on /api/events.
rca_of_the_issue: Profile phone bug RCA: server.py `process_session` originally returned the OAuth-provided fields (email/name/picture/session_token) only, so on every re-login the frontend hydrated user with a stripped-down doc — phone/city/role were lost from the AuthContext until the user navigated to /profile which then called /auth/me. FIX: process_session now `await db.users.find_one({user_id})` after upsert and returns the full doc (server.py L214–216). /auth/me was already returning the full doc via get_current_user, so the second half of the fix was purely frontend hydration on session bootstrap. Verified: seeded a user with phone='+91 9876543210' city='Delhi' role='attendee', GET /api/auth/me now returns all fields (test_me_returns_phone_city_role in test_clann_iteration6.py) AND the /profile UI Row for phone displays '+91 9876543210' instead of '—' (screenshot captured).
